cases.objective: The chatbot's mic opens the Module 6 voice assistant, which shows the state matching the phone's microphone permission
cases.input: Home → AI chatbot (Module 13) → "Voice assistant"; microphone permission as set on the phone
cases.expected: Voice assistant screen (not the chatbot); granted → "Listening..."; not granted → "Voice input unavailable" with the reason and "Try again"
cases.actual: Phone microphone permission: denied; assistant state: unavailable; reason shown 1; "Try again" 1; chatbot still on top: 0
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M6-01 The chatbot's mic opens the Module 6 voice assistant, which shows the state matching the phone's microphone permission

cases.objective: A quick-action chip is answered from the real session state and spoken with the phone's text-to-speech
cases.input: No active workout; tap the chip "How many reps?"
cases.expected: Reply card says there is no active workout session (no invented numbers); text-to-speech reports no failure; at most 3 chips
cases.actual: Reply: "There's no active workout session right now. Open an exercise and tap Start Exercise to begin."; engine On-device rules (Dialogflow unavailable); speech output failed false; chips 2
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M6-02 A quick-action chip is answered from the real session state and spoken with the phone's text-to-speech

cases.objective: "What's my workout today?" is answered from the personalised plan
cases.input: Test user's plan; tap the chip "What's my workout today?"
cases.expected: Reply names today's plan day, or says today is a rest day, matching the plan
cases.actual: Plan today: rest day; reply "Today is a rest day in your plan. Light walking or stretching is fine if you feel like moving."
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M6-03 "What's my workout today?" is answered from the personalised plan

cases.objective: The close button leaves the voice assistant and the app stays usable
cases.input: Home → chatbot → voice assistant → "Close voice assistant" → Back
cases.expected: Voice assistant closed; chatbot shown; Back returns to Home
cases.actual: Voice assistant closed; chatbot shown 1; Home shown after Back
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M6-04 The close button leaves the voice assistant and the app stays usable
